dogecoin.text: @bitcointwist @danheld @BarrySilbert I'm not talking about conspiracies. I say that dogecoin was initially promoted for the sake of the pump & dump scheme. One short in a million can't do anything. One tweet from Barry can't get over Elon's millions of fans. The "Buy the rumor, sell the fact" rule just worked.

@bitcointwist @danheld @BarrySilbert Bitcoin is important because it was the first. It started the blockchain era. Dogecoin is a joke that people have promoted, but it is managed by whales who hold the volume of coins.
